images.note: Senate-balance beat ('In 1848 the Senate sits at about fifteen each. Perfect balance'; 'The Missouri Compromise line held for thirty years'; the three positions incl. extending the line to the Pacific). Reynolds's political map (1856) thematically displays free vs. slave states and territory open to slavery or freedom — the exact geography of the script's Senate math. Date honesty: 1856 (Kansas-Nebraska era, abolitionist-leaning), slightly post-dates the 1846-50 core but shows the balance the episode teaches. Master 7828x7090; IIIF 2000px (verified 200 OK, 866KB). Alt: none qualified from a different institution. [dupe-fix: replaced shared URL]
images.title: Reynolds's political map of free and slave states (1856)
